title: Okha Hogya Akbar (A.S) Lai
body:
Okha Hogya Akbar (a.s) lai Sughra (A.S) Nu Samjhona
Tu Manta Mann Dayah Reh Jana x2
Akbar(a.s) Nay Mur Naiy Onah
Okha Hogya Akbar (a.s) lai Sughra (A.S) nu Samjhona
1.Keway Sughra(s.a) Nuu Kavay, Bajiy Nah Mehndhi Karbal Vich
Barchi Nal Mehdhiya Lavay Gah x2
Tera Akbar(a.s) Jag Tho Sonah
Okha Hogya Akbar (a.s) lai Sughra (A.S) Nu Samjhona x2
2.Enj Band Ho Vangay, Ay Jandray Fair Kulnay Nai
Ay Ghaar Ay Vairay Ho Van Gay x2
Parvah Si Koiy Naiy Hona
Okha Hogya Akbar (a.s) lai Sughra (A.S) Nu Samjhona x2
3.Naal Babay Day Bitah, Veeran Noo Vaikh Leh Raj Kay
Ik Vari Jay Aa Guzar Gayah x2
Ay Vailah Fair Nay Onah
Okha Hogya Akbar (a.s) lai Sughra (A.S) Nu Samjhona x2
4.Khaak Thay Kadmah Dhi, Dasvi Noo Tho Vi Sojah Vi
Karbal Vich Shaam Gareeba Noo x2
Asah Sarray Khaak Thay Sonah
Okha Hogya Akbar (a.s) lai Sughra (A.S) Nu Samjhona x2
4.Turday Mehmal Akbar(a.s), Maiytha Dhay Vaang Lag Day
Neh
Takdi Raiy Kulliya Akiya Nall x2
Ay Sarah Khaab Darow Nah
